titles.home: Free online image toolkit — local browser

descriptions.home: Image Studio: free browser-based image tools—compress JPG/PNG, crop, resize & rotate, convert PNG/WebP to JPEG, text watermark, flat-color background removal, upscale (interpolation or on-device AI), HTML-to-PNG capture, privacy blur, and webpage skeleton wireframes. Processing stays local; files are not uploaded; no install required—built for fast, privacy-friendly workflows.
descriptions.compress: Reduce JPEG and PNG file size in your browser: tune JPEG quality and cap the long edge for smaller downloads—no upload, privacy-friendly compression.
descriptions.upscale: Upscale photos with fast bilinear scaling or on-device AI super-resolution (TensorFlow.js). Choose 2× or chained 4×; processing stays in the browser.
descriptions.removeBg: Sample a flat background color and use tolerance to cut out white, green screen, or solid backdrops. Export transparent PNG—handled entirely on your device.
descriptions.resize: Scale images by percent or target pixels with optional aspect-ratio lock. Export as JPEG or PNG; all edits happen locally in the browser.
descriptions.crop: Drag handles to crop visually and download PNG—great for screenshots, avatars, and social crops without installing desktop software.
descriptions.convertJpg: Turn PNG, WebP, GIF, and more into JPEG with white behind transparency. Adjust quality for smaller files and broader platform support.
descriptions.rotate: Rotate with 90°/180°/270° presets or a custom angle to fix orientation. Download PNG or JPEG after instant local preview.
descriptions.watermark: Overlay customizable text with placement, color, size, and opacity. Export PNG for proofs, samples, or copyright notices—processed locally.
descriptions.meme: Add classic white-on-black-stroke captions at the top and bottom. Multi-line friendly; export PNG memes locally in seconds.
descriptions.htmlToImage: Render HTML in-page and capture a PNG—handy for cards and previews. External assets need CORS; use trusted snippets only.
descriptions.blur: Blur a percentage-based rectangle to hide IDs, plates, or sensitive UI. Export PNG or JPEG; blur runs locally for privacy redaction.
descriptions.webSkeleton: Render an HTML snippet in a sandbox and generate a wireframe skeleton (placeholder blocks) from layout and text—export HTML or PNG for loading states; same core algorithm as the Skeleton Generator extension, runs locally.

footer.line: Images are processed locally in your browser and are not uploaded.

home.title: Image Studio — Free Online Image Toolkit
home.lead: Edit images entirely in your browser: compress to shrink file size, crop and reframe, resize by ratio or pixels, rotate and convert formats, add text watermarks, cut out solid-color backgrounds, upscale with fast scaling or local AI super-resolution, export HTML snippets to PNG, blur sensitive areas, and generate wireframe skeleton previews. Everything runs on your device—no uploads and no install—so you can work quickly without sending photos to a server.

compress.lead: Reduce size via JPEG quality and/or long-edge limit; PNG stays lossless and mainly shrinks by dimensions.

resize.lead: Scale proportionally or set width (optional aspect lock).

crop.lead: Drag the crop box and handles, then export PNG.

convertJpg.lead: Convert PNG, WebP, GIF, etc. to JPEG; transparency is filled white.

rotate.lead: After upload, use the dial in the dialog for a live preview; shortcuts for 90°/180°/270° are available.
rotate.knobHint: Press and drag on the circular dial—the image rotates with it.

watermark.lead: Blue outline = selection (transparent inside). Drag the frame edge or padding (not the text) to move; corner dots scale font size. Empty: blinking caret—click to type. With text: double-click to edit. The field has no chrome and may extend outside the image (preview has padding). Adjust opacity and color below.
watermark.fontLicenseNote: All choices use open licenses (SIL OFL 1.1 or Apache-2.0), loaded via Google Fonts.
watermark.dragHint: Drag the frame border or padding to move (not the text). Corner handles scale font size. Empty: click the caret to type. With text: double-click to edit. No input border; text area can extend past the image.
watermark.dragHandle: Drag inside the frame to move
watermark.resizeHandle: Drag to resize the text box

meme.lead: Large top and bottom text with white fill and black stroke (use line breaks for multiple lines).

upscale.lead: Two modes: fast bilinear scaling at any percent, or local neural super-resolution (waifu2x/Bigjpg-style idea via UpscalerJS + TensorFlow.js in your browser).
upscale.leadFast: Uses pica locally for high-quality upscales (default Lanczos-3 kernel, WASM + worker tiling). If pica fails to start, we fall back to stepped canvas resampling.
upscale.leadAi: RDN model outputs ~2× per pass; 4× runs two 2× passes (slower). First run downloads weights; all inference is local.
upscale.aiEdgeNote: To limit GPU memory, images longer than {n}px on the long edge are shrunk before AI upscaling.
upscale.aiShrunk: Long edge was limited to {n}px before AI upscaling.

removeBg.lead: Best for flat or near-flat backgrounds. Click the preview to sample the background color, then tune tolerance and feather.
removeBg.hintPick: Click the background on the preview to sample:

htmlToImage.lead: Render the snippet below and capture it. Inline styles are most reliable; remote images need CORS.
htmlToImage.warnTitle: Do not paste HTML from untrusted sources (same risks as visiting a random webpage). Only use snippets you trust.

blur.lead: Drag the dashed box on the preview to choose the region; drag corners to resize. Blur strength is the radius below.
blur.regionHint: Drag inside the box to move; drag a corner handle to resize.

webSkeleton.lead: Your HTML is rendered in a hidden sandbox; we walk the DOM and emit gray placeholder blocks (fixed + viewport %) like the Skeleton Generator extension. Change background color and click Generate again. Scripts do not run in the sandbox.
webSkeleton.warnTitle: Do not paste HTML from untrusted sources. Scripts are blocked, but remote assets may still be requested.
webSkeleton.granularityHint: Lower = coarser, larger blocks; higher = finer text strips. After generating, drag the slider to refresh live (same as the extension).
